description: This file is a shell script used to initialize and manage WWAN (Wireless Wide Area Network) interfaces in a network configuration. It includes functions for setting up various WWAN protocols (mbim, qmi, ncm, 3g, directip), detects connected USB WWAN devices, and handles their configuration and teardown.

methods.name: proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Handles setup for MBIM protocol, reports missing implementation.

methods.name: proto_qmi_setup
methods.description: Handles setup for QMI protocol, reports missing implementation.

methods.name: proto_ncm_setup
methods.description: Handles setup for NCM protocol, reports missing implementation.

methods.name: proto_3g_setup
methods.description: Handles setup for 3G protocol, reports missing implementation.

methods.name: proto_directip_setup
methods.description: Handles setup for direct IP protocol, reports missing implementation.

methods.name: proto_wwan_init_config
methods.description: Initializes WWAN interface configuration options, adding necessary parameters.

methods.name: proto_wwan_setup
methods.description: Main setup function that detects the USB WWAN device and configures the appropriate protocol.

methods.name: proto_wwan_teardown
methods.description: Teardown function to deactivate WWAN protocol and clean up configuration.
